description: Split the web session-transcript widget: relocate pure diff/patch calculation and the transcript state machine to the model layer, and split per-tool content views into ui/tool-views/. Pure internal refactor — no behavior, public barrel, or spec-level change.

tasks.title: Relocate diff/patch calculation to model/diff-builder.ts
tasks.description: Move the pure diff/patch calculation (buildDiffFromEdit, buildDiffFromPatchText, extractPatchForFile) and the FileBlock type out of ui/AssistantParts.tsx into a new model/diff-builder.ts, consolidating with the patch parsing already in transcript-tool-utils.ts to eliminate the model/UI split-brain. The diff rendering components (DiffContentView, PatchDiffView, DiffBlockView) stay in UI and import the calc from the new model module. Add unit tests for the moved pure functions to lock output before/after.
acceptanceCriteria: buildDiffFromEdit, buildDiffFromPatchText, extractPatchForFile and the FileBlock type are exported from model/diff-builder.ts and no longer defined in ui/AssistantParts.tsx
ui/AssistantParts.tsx diff rendering components import the calc from model/diff-builder.ts; no pure diff computation remains in the UI layer
model/diff-builder.test.ts asserts FileBlock[] output for representative edit (oldStr/newStr) and patchText inputs, including the extractPatchForFile file-selection path
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes (useSessionTranscript.test.tsx unchanged and green)
tasks.notes: Step 1 of design D4 (layer correction first, lowest risk, establishes baseline). No spec is added/modified — existing agent-session-ui / session-timeline-ui specs are the preserved-behavior contract, not a change target.

tasks.title: Extract pure transcript state machine to model/transcript-state.ts
tasks.description: Move the React-independent state-transition functions from useSessionTranscript.ts (currently lines 59-613: create*/append*/close*/ensure* helpers, findToolByCorrelation, buildLiveToolDetails, updateToolInTurn, and the small asRecord/getString/getNumber payload helpers) verbatim into a new model/transcript-state.ts. The hook imports them and keeps only reactive wiring (subscriptions, streaming, effects). Preserve exact signatures and transition semantics — relocate, do not re-author into a new reducer shape.
acceptanceCriteria: All pure state-transition functions are exported from model/transcript-state.ts and removed from useSessionTranscript.ts
useSessionTranscript.ts contains only the hook's reactive wiring (useState/useRef/useEffect/useCallback, subscriptions, streaming timers); no pure (state,event)->state logic remains inline
model/transcript-state.ts has no React imports (directly unit-testable without a test renderer)
transcript-state.test.ts asserts at least appendInputTurn/appendTextToTurn/closeActiveTextPart/updateToolInTurn outcomes directly; existing useSessionTranscript.test.tsx passes unchanged
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes
tasks.notes: Design D2/D4 step 2. Independent of T-001 (different files, no overlap) but ordered after it to keep one green baseline. A true reducer consolidation is a Non-Goal — only relocate. Decide at implementation whether payload helpers stay in transcript-state.ts or factor into model/payload-helpers.ts based on reuse by diff-builder.

tasks.title: Split per-tool content views into ui/tool-views/
tasks.description: First capture a render-test baseline for the current tool views (none exist today), then move the per-tool content views out of ui/AssistantParts.tsx into ui/tool-views/ grouped by family: bash-view, read-view, search-view, todo-view, delegation-view, diff-view (rendering only — calc comes from model/diff-builder via T-001), plus shared.tsx for cross-cutting helpers (ToolStatusDot, ToolIcon, truncateOutput, getToolDisplayLabel/Args/Subtitle) and index.tsx re-exporting ToolRowView + ContextGroupView. AssistantParts.tsx is left with only the basic part views and the top-level part dispatcher.
acceptanceCriteria: Render/component tests covering the current BashContentView, ReadContentView, SearchContentView, TodoContentView, DelegationContentView, and DiffContentView output are committed as a baseline BEFORE the move
Each content view lives in its family file under ui/tool-views/; cross-cutting helpers are in ui/tool-views/shared.tsx; ToolRowView and ContextGroupView are in ui/tool-views/index.tsx
ui/tool-views/diff-view.tsx imports diff calculation from model/diff-builder (T-001), never redefines it
ui/AssistantParts.tsx contains only AssistantTextPartView, ReasoningPartView, ErrorPartView, DividerPartView and the AssistantParts dispatcher; no tool content view remains inline
The baseline render tests pass against the split files with unchanged output (rendering equivalence)
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes
tasks.notes: Design D3/D4 step 3. Depends on T-001 because diff-view consumes model/diff-builder. Baseline render tests are mandatory — there is currently zero automated coverage for AssistantParts/tool-view rendering, so the split would be blind without them. Enforce layering: ui/tool-views/* import from model/* only, never from AssistantParts.tsx.

packages/web/src/widgets/session-transcript/index.ts exports exactly and only projectTurn, useSessionTranscript, SessionTranscriptLayout (public barrel contract unchanged)
